name: BSF (US-Israel Binational Science Foundation), in memory of Prof. Anton Post
collect_note: The BSF Climate Solutions card on the official BSF homepage is read twice a day. It shows a pre-proposal submission date of April 7, 2027. The program's own pages still say 'to be announced', so confirm the date with BSF before relying on it.
evidence: Plain HTTP 2026-11-12: https://www.bsf.org.il/ HTTP 200, homepage card 'BSF Climate Solutions / More about BSF Climate Solutions / Submission Date / April 7, 2027'; other cards (BSF Research Grants Dec 2 2026, NSF-BSF Joint Research Grants, Prof. Rahamimoff Travel Grants Dec 16 2026, NEH-BSF Programs) do not contain 'Climate Solutions'. https://www.bsf.org.il/funding-opportunities/new-program/ shows 'To be announced - Submission Date Pre-Proposals' and the about page says 'Early April: Pre-Proposals deadline' (consistent with early April 2027, cycle is bi-annual; 2025 call was pre-proposals Apr 2 2025). Announcements list (https://www.bsf.org.il/about/announcements/) only has the Jan 9 2025 call. Web search found no 2027 call document.
